units.source_text: 源氏公子回到二条院私邸，终日卧床饮泣。

en.t: Prince Genji returned to his private residence at Nijo-in and lay in bed all day weeping.

units.source_text: 写了慰问信送去，王命妇回来说她是照例不看的。

en.t: He wrote and sent a letter of comfort, but O no Myobu came back and said that, as usual, she would not look at it.

units.source_text: 此虽是常有之事，但公子心中更增烦恼。

en.t: Although this was nothing unusual, it only deepened the prince's distress.

units.source_text: 他只是茫茫然地沉思冥想，宫中也不去朝觐，在私邸笼闭了两三天。

en.t: He simply sat lost in vague brooding, did not go to court, and shut himself up at his residence for two or three days.

units.source_text: 想起父皇或许会担心他又生病了，心中不免惶恐。

en.t: When he thought that his imperial father might worry he had fallen ill again, he could not help feeling uneasy and ashamed.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子也悲叹自己命苦，病势加重了。

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo too lamented her bitter fate, and her illness grew worse.

units.source_text: 皇上屡次遣使催她早日回宫，但她无意回去。

en.t: The emperor repeatedly sent messengers urging her to return to the palace soon, but she had no wish to go back.

units.source_text: 她觉得此次病状与往常不同，私下寻思：莫非是怀孕了？

en.t: She felt that this illness was different from usual and wondered privately whether she might be pregnant.

units.source_text: 心中更觉烦闷，不知今后如何是好，方寸缭乱了。

en.t: Her heart grew still more troubled; not knowing what she should do from then on, she was utterly distraught.
